reason: A three-tier memory control plane for DeepSeek Harness that manages runtime context, searchable project documents, and provider-backed long-term memory through supervised workflows.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供三层记忆控制平面，管理运行时上下文、可搜索项目文档和可插拔的长期记忆。
summaries.en: A three-tier memory control plane for DeepSeek Harness that manages runtime context, searchable project documents, and pluggable long-term memory.

capabilities: maintains persistent runtime context across turns and sessions
searches project documents and stored memory
writes and updates memory through supervised agent workflows
integrates with configurable local and external memory providers
